evals.name: wireframe-settings-page
evals.prompt: Wireframe a settings page for our app — a sidebar with nav items on the left (Profile, Notifications, Billing, Security), and a main panel on the right with a couple of toggle rows and a Save button at the bottom. I want to drop it into the proposal.md for the redesign.
evals.expected_output: A box-drawing (Unicode ┌─┐│└┘) text wireframe, not HTML. Uses the ascii-wireframe canon: sidebar with `›`-prefixed items, toggle rows, a boxed button, fenced for markdown. Lives inline in the doc, no browser/screenshot.

evals.name: ascii-mockup-dashboard
evals.prompt: Give me an ASCII mockup of an analytics dashboard layout: a top navbar, three KPI cards in a row, and a wide data table below them. Low-fi is fine, I just want to show roughly where things sit in the spec.
evals.expected_output: Box-drawing text mockup composed from canon recipes (navbar `≡` + items, three card boxes aligned in a row, a table with `├─┼─┤` header rule). May reach for scripts/bin/wireframe-render given the alignment-heavy multi-region layout. Output is plain box-drawing text, fenced.

evals.name: low-fi-checkout-flow
evals.prompt: Sketch a low-fi layout for the checkout flow — a card with the order summary, an input for the promo code, a payment-method select, and a primary 'Place order' button. Just a rough text sketch for the beads issue.
evals.expected_output: A box-drawing text wireframe authored from the canon: a rounded card frame, an input field row, a select with `▾` chevron, and a boxed primary button. Suitable to paste into a beads comment as plain text. Not HTML, not a React component.

evals.name: negative-production-react-form
evals.prompt: Build a production React signup form component with email/password fields, client-side validation, and a submit handler that calls our tRPC auth.signup mutation. Style it with our shadcn components.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger ascii-wireframe. This is production UI work (real React + shadcn + tRPC), which belongs to frontend-design / shadcn / t3-code-patterns — not a low-fi text sketch.

evals.name: negative-brand-color-palette
evals.prompt: Design a brand color palette and type scale for our new fintech product — primary, accent, neutrals, semantic colors, plus heading and body font pairings. Output design tokens.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger ascii-wireframe. This is brand identity / design-token work for bootstrap:design or frontend-design. No UI layout sketch is involved, so the box-drawing canon does not apply.
